caveats: Different task: the challenge is concept-level entity linking over 6,595 concepts; RobustEHR needs category-level typing over 11.
Different system class: the winners are purpose-built and two are trained on the challenge's training split. This is an untrained off-the-shelf matcher scored as a baseline.
Different evaluation set: the challenge's test set was held out and is not public. This scores the test-marked rows of the release.
Concept identity is reached through UMLS CUIs and credited when any of a CUI's SNOMED codes matches, which is more forgiving.
metric: character IoU, macro-averaged by concept (the challenge's metric)
system: QuickUMLS via medspaCy, default parameters, untrained
